title: Judit Polgár and the Experiment in Genius
grammar: Emphatic universal concessives with bárki + subjunctive/indicative and bármilyen + noun
goal: I can explain the Polgár family's experiment and Judit Polgár's chess career.
I can use bárki ... is and bármilyen ... is to say that something holds whoever or however it is.
I can discuss chess strategy, grandmaster tournaments, and gender stereotypes in Hungarian.
